title: {Syn} LLL Finds Short Lattice Vectors
content:
The Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovasz lattice basis reduction algorithm finds a relatively short, nearly orthogonal basis in polynomial time.

LLL has uses in cryptanalysis, integer programming, computational number theory, and polynomial factorization over rational numbers.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
